basic_details.short_information: Centre for DNA Fingerprinting and Diagnostics (CDFD), Hyderabad, Telangana, has invited applications for 6 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. 04/2026. The posts include Scientist - V, Scientist - IV, Scientist - III. The online application is open from 31 October 2026 to 31 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CDFD Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Register online using the New Registration button on the website http://www.cdfd.org.in. Remit the application fee through SBI Collect payment link under Advt No. 04/2026. Log in to the portal using credentials and fill out the online application form. Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, certificates, publications, and other required documents in specified formats. Submit the application form and take a printout for future reference. Apply on or before 31 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: All Women candidates, SC, ST, Ex-servicemen and PwBD candidates are exempted from application fee upon uploading proof Candidates applying for more than one post need to register separately for each post with separate fee payment

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CDFD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 31 December 2026. Applications opened on 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CDFD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 2 Scientist - V, 2 Scientist - IV, 2 Scientist - III.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CDFD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Unreserved candidates: ₹ 1500. EWS/OBC candidates: ₹ 1500.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Scientist - V: maximum 45 years; Scientist - IV: maximum 40 years; Scientist - III: maximum 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 13 (₹ 1,23,100 ) for Scientist - V, Level 12 (₹ 78,800 ) for Scientist - IV, Level 11 (₹ 67,700 ) for Scientist - III.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ph.D in Life Sciences / Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Chemistry / Computational Biology / Pharmaceutical Sciences / Molecular Biology / Agricultural Sciences / Plant Sciences / Engineering / Technology / MD / MDS / MVSc. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. The applicant must be a citizen of India. All New Entrants will be governed by the National Pension Scheme. Selected candidates are required to work anywhere in India depending on the requirement of the Centre.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates appearing in final year or awaiting final examination result.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting by the Screening Committee based on advertised terms. Screened-in candidates may be requested to send an audio-recorded PPT presentation detailing ongoing research areas and future plans. Evaluation of presentations by Preliminary Selection Committee for further shortlisting. Final interviews by the Selection Committee.
